benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: YES Bank SELECT Credit Card, **previously known as YES Prosperity EDGE Credit Card** , is a reward-focused card offering accelerated value-back on online spends. The card also offers rewards on categories that are often excluded such as utilities, education, insurance, etc. though at a much lower rate. However, while the earning rate is high, the redemption value of up to Rs. 0.25 brings down the overall value-back. Apart from its rewards program, the card extends travel and lifestyle benefits such as complimentary domestic lounge access and golf benefits. Read the detailed features and benefits of the card below, along with reviews, pros and cons.
highlights: 8 YES Rewardz Points for every Rs. 200 spent on online transactions
4 YES Rewardz Points for every Rs. 200 spent on offline transactions
2 YES Rewardz Points for every Rs. 200 spent on select categories
2X rewards above the regular reward rate on online spends
milestone_benefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver for fuel spends between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000
golf_benefits: 4 complimentary rounds of green fees every year at select golf courses in India
1 complimentary golf lesson at select golf courses in India

golf_summary.extra_notes: Strong budget card with green fee waivers

get_this_card_if: You mostly shop online and would like to save on your online spends
You want to earn rewards on utilities, insurance and education spends
You travel only a few times in a year and do not need many travel-centric features
You already have other cards catering to dining, movies and other lifestyle spends

faqs.q: What is the credit limit on YES Bank SELECT Credit Card?
faqs.a: The credit limit is determined basis your income, current debts, and several other internal policies of the bank. The credit limit assigned to you will be disclosed only when you receive the card.

faqs.q: Does YES Bank SELECT Credit Card offer international lounge access?
faqs.a: No. There is no complimentary international lounge visit on YES Bank SELECT Credit Card.

faqs.q: How to avail golf benefit on YES Bank SELECT Credit Card?
faqs.a: To book a golf game, you can call the toll free number for golf concierge – 1800-102-6263. You would not get golf lessons at all golf courses, so if you want to avail the complimentary lesson, you must choose the right golf course. Bookings must be made at least 5 days in advance. You can read the detailed terms and conditions on YES Bank’s website.

faqs.q: I already have a YES Bank credit card. Can I apply for YES SELECT Credit Card?
faqs.a: No. Existing YES Bank credit cardholders are not eligible for this credit card.

pros_and_cons.editorial_summary: option from YES BANK suited for travel & miles users.
pros: Accelerated rewards on all online spends irrespective of category or brand
Comparatively lower forex mark-up fee of 2.75%
Low annual fee and easily achievable fee waiver condition
Up to 4 free golf rounds and 12 free golf lessons in a year
cons: Low redemption value of reward points
Only 4 free domestic lounge visits in a year and tied to a spend-based condition
